pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take:
**Rafe picked half his teams like he was throwin' darts at a map blindfolded — Germany's the only thing keepin' "The Noisemaker" in the game.** Listen up, Rafe's tryin' to rally his ragtag squad of non-qualifyin' favorites, but let's just say his "strategic chaos" ain’t workin’ out like he thought. Rafe out here thinkin' Uzbekistan's gonna pull a miracle just 'cause he saw 'em in FIFA's best goals of 2012. I reckon Tunisia and Scotland are just along for the ride, livin' on borrowed time.

Meanwhile, Gunner's sittin' pretty up top thanks to his French connection — my man "Bubba G" backed France like they’re the surest thing since Texas BBQ. With Senegal and Morocco lookin' like they're ready to grind it out in any weather, Gunner might be pullin' away faster than a winger on a break. Mustard Boy Zach's down in fourth, still waitin' on that Saudi oil money to spark some magic goals, but you can't blame him for havin' faith in Ghana and Czechia to give him a leg up.

Devin's holdin' his ground in second, though. Thanks to Spain's tidy win over Portugal, he's churnin' up those points steady like Ghost Pepper in the clutch. His USA squad met Belgium and got cooked, but I reckon Norway and that wild card Haiti might just do some surprise damage. Remember, folks, puttin' your money on Rafe's "mystery box" of teams ain't the move unless you just love livin' dangerously.
